[*Microeconomics: Competition, Conflict, and Coordination*](https://global.oup.com/academic/product/microeconomics-9780198843207)
was published by Oxford University Press in 2022. It was written by Samuel
Bowles and Simon D. Halliday.

The book develops microeconomics around competition, conflict, coordination,
institutions, power, and social preferences. It reflects the way many students
now encounter economic life: not only through markets, but also through firms,
families, politics, norms, and collective action.

We will rebuild the textbook as an open web project. This page will link to the
open site once that work is ready.
